# Share bots, sections and groups across the space

## What to build

Make every member of a space see and use all bots, bot sections and chat groups in it, not just the ones they created. Convert the bot, section and group queries in `packages/db/src/repos.ts`, `packages/db/src/groups.ts` and their API callers from `(spaceId, userId)` to `spaceId` only, so `bots.list`, `bots.get`/update/archive/remove, sections, `groups.*`, the sidebar navigation (`spaces.list`) and search return the space's content for any member. This unblocks thread sharing, because every thread RPC resolves its bot or group through `getBot` / `getGroupTarget`.

## The sharing rule (decided; apply exactly)

- **Space content**: filter by `spaceId: actor.spaceId` (or `run.spaceId`) only. Drop `userId: actor.userId` from `where` clauses of reads, updates and deletes. Keep `userId: actor.userId` on `create`; it now means "created by".
- **Personal data** (voice, model preferences/credentials/role choices, AI-data consent, notification preferences, push tokens, devices, messaging identities, account secrets/vault with `spaceId: null`, trusted link sites, setting overrides): keep the `userId` filter. Do not touch those queries in this slice.
- Membership is checked once in actor resolution (`requireMembership` from `x-rakazo-space-id`, `apps/api/src/app.ts:915-923`; `authed` middleware runs handlers in `runAsTenant`, `apps/api/src/routes/context.ts:343-354`). Never trust a client `spaceId` without the `asMemberOf` check in `apps/api/src/routes/spaces.ts:35-47`.
- Private spaces have one member, so results there must be identical to before.
- The audit that found these queries covered `apps/api/src`, `apps/worker/src` and `packages/db/src` only. Also run `grep -rn "userId: actor.userId\|userId: run.userId\|userId: input.userId\|userId: scope.userId" packages/adapters/src packages/core/src packages/memory/src` for this slice's models and convert the space-content ones the same way.

Already in the codebase (earlier slices): `Space.kind` (`"private" | "team"`); `scoped()` in `packages/db/src/scope.ts` checks `spaceId` only; RLS policies are space-based for space content; and `seedSharedSpaceFixture(prisma, { kind?: "team" })` exported from `@rakazo/db` (`packages/db/src/shared-space-fixture.ts`) returns `{ organizationId, spaceId, owner: Actor, member: Actor, outsider: Actor, cleanup() }` — one space with an owner and a member, plus an outsider in their own personal space. Use it in every Postgres test here.

## Test pattern for every converted procedure

In a `*.postgres.test.ts` (pattern: `apps/api/src/board-rename.postgres.test.ts` lines 10-75 — `createRouterClient(createRouter({ prisma, env } as unknown as RouterDeps), { context: { actor } })`, fixtures inside `runAsSystem`):
1. owner creates the item through the RPC (or a DB helper);
2. `member` lists/reads/updates it through the RPC → succeeds and sees it;
3. `outsider` with `actor.spaceId = fixture.spaceId` is never produced by actor resolution (it would 401); instead assert the outsider in their own space does not see it, and that a direct read with the shared item's id from the outsider's actor → `NOT_FOUND`.


## Context: files to read before implementing

- `packages/db/src/repos.ts` — bot/section queries (all filter `spaceId` + `userId` today): botSection 172 `findMany`, 273 `aggregate`, 286 `findUniqueOrThrow` (`spaceId_userId_name`), 314 `findFirst`; bot 188, 375, 590, 723 `findMany`, 253, 502 (`getBot`, quoted below), 551, 743 `findFirst`, 582 `aggregate`; chatGroup 262 `findFirst`.
  ```ts
  // packages/db/src/repos.ts:501-513 getBot
  const bot = await prisma.bot.findFirst({
    where: { id: botId, spaceId: actor.spaceId, userId: actor.userId, ...(archived ? {} : { archivedAt: null }) },
  ```
- `packages/db/src/groups.ts` — 114 bot.findMany; chatGroup 303, 340, 368 `findMany`; 387, 401 (`getGroupTarget`, 400-411), 464, 563 `findFirst`.
- `packages/db/src/scope.ts` lines 11-17 — `BotSectionNameConflictError` (sections are unique per `(spaceId, userId, name)` in the schema).
- `packages/db/src/bot-update.ts`, `bot-instructions.ts`, `bot-avatar-choice.ts` — check for `userId` filters on bot updates.
- `packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma` 640-707 (`Bot`, index `[spaceId, userId, archivedAt, pinned, updatedAt]`), 710-726 (`BotSection`), 741-760 (`ChatGroup`).
- API callers: `apps/api/src/routes/bots.ts` 308 (botMcpServer.findMany), 336 and 625 (botSection.findFirst), 569 (webhook `secret.deleteMany`); `apps/api/src/routes/shared.ts` 124 (bot.findMany); `apps/api/src/bot-thread.ts` 11; `apps/api/src/search.ts` 116 (bots), 159 (groups); `apps/api/src/routes/messaging.ts` 120; `apps/api/src/voice.ts` 243; `apps/api/src/thread-image-admission.ts` 48; `apps/api/src/taught-skills.ts` 318; `apps/api/src/routes/mcp.ts` 669, 702, 766; `apps/api/src/mcp-approval.ts` 301; `apps/api/src/ai-consent.ts` 63 — every `bot.findFirst/findMany` there filters by `userId` too; convert them all here (only the bot/section/group lookups; leave other models in those files to their own slices).
- `apps/api/src/routes/spaces.ts` 228-356 — `memberSpaceNavigation` uses `repos.listBots(actor)` and group repos; after this slice it lists every member's bots and groups.
- Existing tests: `packages/db/src/list-bots.postgres.test.ts`, `packages/db/src/bot-sections.postgres.test.ts`, `packages/db/src/groups.test.ts`, `packages/db/src/space-bots-preview.postgres.test.ts`.

## Patterns to follow

- Section names: keep the schema's unique key, but before create/rename check `botSection.findFirst({ where: { spaceId, name } })` in the same transaction and throw `BotSectionNameConflictError` so names are unique per space for users.
- Index: the bot list query now filters `spaceId, archivedAt, pinned`; the existing `[spaceId, userId, ...]` index no longer matches. Add `@@index([spaceId, archivedAt, pinned, updatedAt])` on `Bot` and `@@index([spaceId, archivedAt, pinned, updatedAt])` on `ChatGroup` with a `_concurrent` migration `packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261111150000_space_bot_group_indexes_concurrent/migration.sql` using `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS` (mirror `20261110120000_external_effects_space_kind_status_idx_concurrent`). Do not drop the old indexes.

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `packages/db/src/repos.ts` and `packages/db/src/groups.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: drop `userId: actor.userId` from every bot, botSection and chatGroup read/update/delete `where`; keep it in `create` data. Section name conflict check per space.
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm --filter @rakazo/db check`

### UPDATE the API callers listed above
- **IMPLEMENT**: same conversion for the bot/section/group queries only.
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm --filter @rakazo/api check`

### CREATE migration for the new indexes (see Patterns) and add the `@@index` lines to `schema.prisma`.

### CREATE `apps/api/src/shared-bots.postgres.test.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT** with `seedSharedSpaceFixture`: owner creates a bot (`bots.create`) and a group (`groups.create`) and a section; `member` sees them in `bots.list`, `groups.list` and `spaces.list` (current space bots), can `bots.update` the owner's bot name, can archive and restore it, can move it to a section; `outsider` (own space) gets `NOT_FOUND` for `bots.get`-style calls with the bot id; member creating a section with the same name as the owner's → conflict error. Private-space regression: a single-user space still lists its bots.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Any member lists, opens, edits, archives and deletes any bot or group in the space.
- [ ] Sections are shared and unique by name per space.
- [ ] Non-members get `NOT_FOUND`; private spaces unchanged.
- [ ] Every converted procedure has a member and a non-member assertion.

## Validation commands

```bash
pnpm db:generate
pnpm check --affected || pnpm check
pnpm lint
pnpm exec vitest run apps/api/src packages/db/src
pnpm test:integration -- --spec=shared-bots
```

## Project rules that apply (from AGENTS.md)

- Public repo: no secrets, real emails or private URLs in code, tests or fixtures. Test emails use `@rakazo.test`.
- Use top-level `import type`, never inline type imports. Dynamic `import()` only for deferred loading.
- Migrations must work with the previous release running side by side: only add tables/columns (nullable or with a default). Never drop or rename in this task. Folder name `packages/db/prisma/migrations/YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_snake_name/migration.sql`; use a timestamp after `20261110120000` and unique to this task (the suffix in this task's text). First line is a comment such as `-- Additive: older releases never read or write these columns.`
- Every table with row-level security must be listed in `ROW_SECURITY_MODELS` (`packages/db/src/row-security.ts:96`), enforced by `packages/db/src/row-security.postgres.test.ts:789-799`. New tables follow `packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261109120000_audit_events/migration.sql:57-60` (ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY + a `_system` policy on `current_setting('app.rls_bypass', true) = 'on'`) and `20261022120000_row_level_security_tenant_tables` for tenant policies.
- Database access in tests and app code must run inside `runAsTenant` / `runAsSystem` (`packages/db/src/row-security.ts:27-40`); the vitest setup (`packages/testkit/src/pin-test-env.ts`) fails a suite that touches the database outside them.
- Tests are deterministic and offline. Postgres suites are `*.postgres.test.ts`, skipped unless `VERIFY_DATABASE=1` and `DATABASE_URL` are set (`describe.skipIf(!enabled).sequential(...)`, see `apps/api/src/board-rename.postgres.test.ts:10-13`).
- The API owns authorization and validation; frontends express intent and render state.
- Keep UI copy minimal: no explainer text that repeats the interface. Colors only via `@rakazo/ui-tokens` semantic tokens; reuse `packages/ui-web` components.
- Coordinate across instances through Postgres (transactions, advisory locks, claims), never in-process locks or in-memory counters.
- Do not run the desktop Playwright suite (`pnpm --filter @rakazo/desktop test:e2e`) locally.
